mistakes: Import @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui/styles.css once at the app entry. The Vue parts carry no styles; without the stylesheet they render unstyled.
Put class="hb" on the body or a root wrapper, or the paper surface, prose defaults and grain are missing.
Never add a style block, inline hex or raw px to a part or a page. Every value is a token in tokens.css; a missing look is a missing class in hackbuild.css.
One pink action per view: HbButton variant="go". variant="primary" is light since 0.10.0.
Import from the package root or /vanilla only, never from dist paths.
Vue is an optional peer. A page without Vue uses the classes and @virgilvox/hackbuild-ui/vanilla.
A page opened from file:// or offline loads fonts-inline.css; fonts-local.css needs http and fonts.css needs the network.
Rack tabs are three to five and the first is the live result, never settings.
HbModelSelect and HbModelSheet are pure views: rows in, a choice out. They never fetch or load a model; the app passes rows and acts on the choice.

Parts deprecated in 0.10.0 (HbCard, HbActions, HbReadouts, HbSegMeter, HbPresetChips, HbStageOverlay, HbWakeGate, HbEngineBar, HbModelSlot, HbModelRack, HbTierCards, HbModelList, HbModelManager, HbCustomModelForm, HbMethodCard, HbLoader, HbHash, HbReasons, HbCapabilities, HbStatusBar, HbNum) go in 0.11.0; use the part their console note names.
UI copy is lowercase and terse with no emoji, dashes or exclamation marks; a failure names itself in words.
